text:
maria_support: Customer reports SSE stream closed mid-response after switching from mobile data to a cafe Wi-Fi. Partial JSON arrived, then client saw net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET. Request id: req_abc123, model: rdx-llm-v1, ~1.2k streamed tokens.

sachin_oncall: Can you paste the request_id + any client logs? Also: is there a gateway/proxy in front of us? Token refresh in flight?

maria_support: Pasted logs from customer: 'fetchStream aborted', 'OkHttp: java.io.EOFException' and system shows TLS close from client. No explicit fetch to reauth around the time. They attached a quick curl they used to repro: 

```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <TEMP_TOKEN>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=rdx-llm-v1&session=abcd"
```

kevin_engineer: Server-side trace for req_abc123 shows the connection was active; the edge proxy (edge-proxy-2) logged an upstream idle-close at 30s with TCP FIN then TLS peer reset. Looks like the proxy treated the socket as idle despite steady outbound token traffic (small intervals).

kevin_engineer: Two hypotheses: 1) multihop network change caused client TCP stack to send RST when IP changed (common on android carrier->wifi). 2) token rotation or app-level reconnect canceled request mid-stream. Also proxy idle thresholds + buffering can amplify.

maria_support: Customer says this only happens when they switch networks or enable their work VPN mid-request. Device: Pixel 6, Android 13, OkHttp 4.10.

qa_bot: Quick repro steps confirmed on-device: 1) start SSE with curl/OkHttp 2) toggle mobile->wifi (ifconfig down/up or airplane-mode quick toggle) 3) observe partial chunk then abort. Repro rate ~60% on that build.

kevin_engineer: Short-term mitigation options: 
- recommend client keepalive/ping every 10-15s (SSE comment line or small noop event)
- increase OkHttp readTimeout on the app during long streams
- adjust edge-proxy idle timeout for SSE endpoints (we currently have 30s) to 90s
- add resumable streaming via a resume_token / last_event_id header so clients can reconnect and continue

maria_support: Customer asks if we can detect these cases and avoid billing for useless partial tokens. They were billed for ~1.2k tokens even though output truncated. @billing_bot can we review?

billing_bot: We bill tokens produced before abort. For goodwill refunds send request_id + customer email and we can issue a one-time credit. We'll log as a billing-edge-case.

maria_support: Sent req_abc123 and customer email. Customer accepted credit.

kevin_engineer: I'll add extra logging to stream metrics to capture TCP close origin (RST vs FIN) and whether edge-proxy did an idle-close. That should help distinguish network-change vs proxy policy. Drafting small patch to attach to request metadata.

sachin_oncall: I'm going to roll a policy change to edge-proxy: bump SSE route idle timeout to 90s behind a feature flag, and enable a header that marks the connection as streaming so LB won't buffer-close. Rolling to canary first. :thumbsup:

maria_support: Customer updated app to do incremental reconnects with a resume token and saw far fewer aborts. They still want us to follow up on proxy timeout change.

kevin_engineer: Follow-ups: 1) PR for TCP-close instrumentation 2) add guidance doc for mobile engineers (OkHttp keepalive & reconnect pattern) 3) edge-proxy policy roll. I'll file the tickets after standup. :eyes:

customer_jess: Thanks team — after enabling client reconnect + keepalive it looks much more stable. Appreciate the quick credit and the follow-up work. :heart:

maria_support: marking resolved for customer; keeping engineering follow-ups assigned. :white_check_mark:
